senses.gloss: कृत- + अकृत कृत- + अकृत, adj. 1. wrought and unwrought. 2. prepared and not prepared.
कृत- + अङ्क कृत- + अङ्क, adj. branded, Man. 8, 281.
कृत- + अञ्जलि कृत- + अञ्जलि, adj. with humble salutation, Man. 4, 154.
कृत- + अनुराग कृत- + अनुराग, adj. f. गा, loving, Rām. 2, 12, 98.

कृत- + अन्त कृत- + अन्त,
 I. adj., f. ता, deciding, Bhāg. P. 9, 6, 13.
 II. m. 1. fate, Rām. 1, 41, 1. 2. a name of the God of Death, Hit. 9, 6. 3. a proved doctrine, Bhag. 18, 13.
कृत- + अन्न कृत- + अन्न, n. dressed food, Man. 9, 213.
कृत-पाद- + अभिवन्दन कृत-पाद- + अभिवन्दन, adj., f. ना, literally, having performed a respectful salutation of the feet, i. e. having made a respectful salutation, Kathās. 22, 131.
कृत- + अभ्यनुज्ञ कृत- + अभ्यनुज्ञ, adj., f. ज्ञा, having received the permission to withdraw, dismissed, Rām. 5, 76, 24.
कृत- + अर्थ कृत- + अर्थ, adj. having attained one's end, satisfied, Rām. 4, 34, 22.
कृत- + अवस्थ कृत- + अवस्थ, adj. brought into court, Man. 8, 60.
कृत- + अस्त्र कृत- + अस्त्र, adj. conversant with the use of missile weapons, MBh. 3, 228.
कृत- + आगस् कृत- + आगस्, adj. guilty, Amar. 43.
कृत्रिम- + आर्त्ति कृत्रिम- + आर्त्ति, adj. feigning sorrow, Daśak. in Chr. 192, 3.
कृत- + आलय कृत- + आलय, adj. 1. having settled. 2. Inhabiting, Rām. 3, 1, 18.
कृत- + उत्साह कृत- + उत्साह, adj., f. हा, having made an effort, Sāv. 4, 21.
कृत- + उदक कृत- + उदक, adj. 1. one who has performed the ceremony of pouring water at obsequies, Rām. 1, 25, 3. 2. one who has performed his religious ablution, MBh. 3, 8141.
कृत- + उद्यम कृत- + उद्यम, adj., f. मा, having made an effort, Kumāras. 5, 3.
कृत- + उद्वाह कृत- + उद्वाह, adj., f. हा, married.
कृत- + उन्माद कृत- + उन्माद, [] adj., f. दा (MBh. 14, 2009), feigning madness, Kathās. 18, 242.
कृत- + कार्य कृत- + कार्य, adj. 1. having accomplished a business, Yājñ. 2, 189. 2. satisfied. [] Rām. 6, 97, 21; 2, 99, 11. 3. not wanting (with instr.), MBh. 13, 3862.

कृत- + काल कृत- + काल,
 I. m. appointed time, Yājñ. 2, 184.
 II. adj. having waited a certain time, MBh. 2, 1875.

1. कृत् कृत्, i. 6, Par. (in epic poetry also Ātm., MBh. 3, 17212; and i. 1, MBh. 3, 11383), base of the pres., etc., कृन्त.
 1. To cut, MBh. 1, 3641.
 2. To cut off, Rām. 3, 75, 4.
 3. To cut down, Pañc. 250, 6.
 4. To cut out, Man. 4, 172; to extract, Man. 8, 12.
 5. To kill, MBh. 1, 5593.
 --Caus. To cut, Pañc. 143, 13.
 --With the prepositions समधि सम्-अधि, To cut in addition, MBh. 3, 13294.
 --With अनु अनु, To cut one by one, MBh. 13, 2906.
 --With अव अव,
 1. To cut off, Suśr. 2, 237, 15.
 2. To destroy, MBh. 1, 6810.
 --Caus. To order a gash to be made on, Man. 8, 281.
 --With उद् उद्,
 1. To cut out, 11, 104 (105).
 2. To pull out, Bhāg. P. 4, 5, 2.
 3. To cut to pieces, Ragh. 12, 49.
 --With नि नि, To cut down, Rām. 3, 33, 36.
 --With विनि वि-नि, To cut off, Rām. 3, 31, 48.
 --With निस् निस्,
 1. To cut out, to separate, MBh. 3, 8846.
 2. To cut down, 1, 2835.
 --With परि परि,
 1. To cut wholly, [] Rām. 6, 39, 21.
 2. To exclude, Man. 4, 219.
 --With प्र प्र, To cut to pieces, MBh. 3, 11383 (i. 1).
 --With वि वि,
 1. To rend, Rām. 3, 56, 39.
 2. To divide, Nal. 10, 17 (i. 1).
 --Caus. To rend, Pañc. 91, 5.
 --With सम्, To cut in pieces, Rām. 3, 25, 6.
 --Cf. Lat. curtus; Goth. giltha, grinda-, dis-skreitan; κερσ in ἀκερσεκόμης, and कर्त्रिका.

2. कृत् कृत्, ii. 7.
 1. To spin, (ved.).
 2. † To surround.

3. ऽकृत् -कृत्, i. e. 1. कृ + त्, latter part of comp. adj.
 1. Making, e. g. क्षेत्रकर्मकृत्, i. e. क्षेत्र-कर्मन्-, m. A husbandman, Kathās. 20, 11; चित्र-, m. A painter, Kathās. 5, 28; जन्मकृत्, i. e. जन्मन्-, m. A father, Bhāg. P. 3, 13, 7; दिन- and दिवस-, m. The sun, MBh. 3, 192; 7, 2935; सु-कृत-, Performing virtuous acts, Man. 3, 37.
 2. Causing, सर्व-भूत-, Causing, or the cause of, all beings, Man. 1, 18; अन्त-, 1. adj. causing death, Rām. 3, 67, 19; 2. death, 5, 23, 17.
 3. Agent of all actions signified by the vb. 1. कृ, e. g. बहु-पत्नी-, Marrying many wives, Brāhmaṇ. 2, 34.

कॄत् कॄत्, i. 10, कीर्तय (rather a denomin. derived from कीर्ति), Par. (in epic poetry also Ātm. MBh. 1, 1549),
 1. To celebrate, Man. 3, 221.
 2. To propound, Man. 10, 131.
 3. To pronounce, Man. 2, 124.
 4. To say, Man. 2, 203.
 5. To call, Man. 10, 19. Anom. ptcple. of the pres. Ātm. कीर्तयान, MBh. 13, 7661.
 --With the prep. अनु अनु,
 1. To mention, Rām. 1, 14, 22.
 2. To repeat, Bhāg. P. 8, 4, 15.
 3. To [] proclaim, MBh. 3, 13259.
 4. To propound. MBh. 2, 994.
 --With समभि सम्-अभि, To tell, MBh. 14, 2066.
 --With उद् उद्, To glorify, Ragh. 10, 33.
 --With परि परि,
 1. To proclaim, Man. 11, 122.
 2. To propound, MBh. 13, 12802.
 3. To glorify, MBh. 13, 7160.
 4. To pronounce, Man. 1, 92.
 --With संपरि सम्-परि, To particularise, Suśr. 2, 268, 21.
 --With प्र प्र,
 1. To propound, Man. 2, 95.
 2. To call, Man. 2, 21.
 3. To approve, Pañc. iv. d. 37.
 --With संप्र सम्-प्र,
 1. To mention, MBh. 13, 4926.
 2. To pronounce, Bhag. 18, 4.
 --With सम् सम्,
 1. To celebrate, Man. 3, 221.
 2. To proclaim, Rām. 4, 59, 3.
 3. To mention, Chr. 13, 4.

कृतक 1. कृ + त + क,
 I. adj.
 1. Adopted, MBh. 13, 2630.
 2. Feigned, Pañc. 188, 5.
 3. False, MBh. 13, 2607.
 II. m. A proper name, Bhāg. P. 9, 24, 47.
 III. कम्, acc. sing. n., adv. Feignedly, Śiś. 9, 83.
 --Comp.
कृतकृत्यता कृत-कृत्य + ता, f. Happiness, Man. 4, 17.
कृतघ्न कृत + घ्न, adj., f. ना, Who returns evil for good, Man. 4, 214.
कृतघ्नता कृतघ्न + ता, f., and कृतघ्नत्व कृतघ्न + त्व, n. Returning [] evil for good, ingratitude, Pañc. 214, 5; Mārk. P. 15, 39.
कृतज्ञ कृत-ज्ञ, adj., f. ञा, Grateful, Man. 7, 209.
कृतज्ञता कृतज्ञ + ता, f. Gratitude, Rām. 5, 35, 16.
कृतहस्तता कृत-हस्त + ता, f. Skilfulness in archery, MBh. 4, 1976.
कृतार्थता कृतार्थता, i. e. कृत-अर्थ + ता, f. Satisfaction, Ragh. 8, 3.
कृतास्त्रता कृतास्त्रता, i. e. कृत-अस्त्र + ता, f. Skilfulness in the use of missile weapons, MBh. 1, 5156.

कृति कृ + ति,
 I. f.
 1. Making, Pañc. 91, 3.
 2. Action, Bhāṣāp. 145.
 3. A literary work, Mālav. 3, 13.
 4. Hurt, Dev. 5, 11 (?).
 II. m. and f. Proper names, MBh. 2, 320; Bhāg. P. 6, 18, 13.
 --Comp.

कृत्ति कृत् + ति, f. A hide.
 --Cf. वासस्.

कृतिन् कृतिन्, i. e. कृत + इन्,
 I. adj., f. नी.
 1. Wise, Bhartṛ. 2, 16.
 2. Clever, MBh. 3, 8278.
 3. Satisfied, Ragh. 3, 51.
 II. m. A proper name, Bhāg. P. 9, 22, 5.
 --Comp.
कृतिमन्त् कृति + मन्त्, adj., f. मती in नाना-देश-, Administering, governing different countries, MBh. 14, 1776.
कृतिसाध्यत्व कृति-साध्य + त्व, n. Being accomplishable by action, Bhāṣāp. 145.
कृत्तिका कृत्तिका, f., generally pl. [] The third of the lunar mansions, MBh. 1, 2588.
कृत्नु कृ-त्नु, adj. Clever, Chr. 295, 10 = Rigv. i. 92, 10.

कृत्य कृ + त्य,
 I. ptcple. of the fut. pass. of कृ.
 1. To be done or performed, Rām. 3, 60, 27.
 2. Seducible, bribable, Rājat. 5, 247.
 II. n.
 1. Right, Pañc. i. d. 309.
 2. Need, with instr., e. g. न मे जीवितेन कृत्यम्, I do not want (or wish) to live, Mṛcch. 154, 3.
 3. Duty, Man. 2, 237.
 4. Service, Śāk. d. 193.
 गुण-कृत्ये नियोजिता, is used to serve as a string, Kumāras. 4, 15.
 5. Business, Rām. 3, 47, 15.
 6. motive, Rām. 6, 33, 18.
 III. f. या.
 1. Causing, Man. 11, 67.
 2. Act, Man. 11, 125.
 3. Charm, witchery, Man. 9, 290.
 --Comp.

कृत- + कृत्य कृत- + कृत्य,
 I. n. 1. what has been done and what must be done. 2. fulfilled intention, MBh. 4, 882.
 II. adj., f. या, satisfied, Rām. 1, 1, 84.
कृत्यका कृत्य + का, f. A witch, Nal. 13, 29.
कृत्यवन्त् कृत्य + वन्त्, adj., f. वती, Occupied.

कृत्रिम कृ + त्रिम,
 I. adj., f. मा.
 1. Factitious, the reverse of what is natural, Pañc. 110, 16.
 2. Feigned, Daśak. in Chr. 192, 5 (cf. आर्ति).
 3. Adopted, Man. 9, 169.
 4. False, Yājñ. 2, 247.
 II. m. An adopted son, Man. 9, 159. []
 --Comp.

ऽकृत्वस् -कृ + त्वस्, adv. forming multiplicative numerals from numerals and other words, e. g. सहस्र-, adv. A thousand times, Man. 2, 79.
 तावत्कृत्वस्, i. e. तावन्त्-, adv. So many times, Man. 5, 38.

कृत्स्न कृत्स्न, adj.
 1. Whole, Man. 1, 105.
 2. All, Rām. 4, 43, 64.
कृत्स्नशस् कृत्स्न + शस्, adv. Completely, Man. 7, 215.
कृत-क्रिय कृत-क्रिय, adj. one who has performed a religious ceremony, e. g. the funeral rites, Man. 5, 99.
कृत- + क्षण कृत- + क्षण, adj., f. णा, expecting impatiently, MBh. 1, 778.
कृत-चूड कृत-चूड, adj. one whose head has been shorn, Man. 5, 58.
कृत- + दार कृत- + दार, adj. married, Man. 4, 1.
कृत-धार कृत-धार, adj. sharpened, MBh. 7, 3090.
कृत- + नाशक कृत- + नाशक adj. ungrateful, Hit. iii. d. 126.

कृत-पूर्व- + नाशन कृत-पूर्व- + नाशन, n. ungratefulness, Hit. 27, 16, n. भूत-,
 I. m. 1. marking nut plant, Semicarpus anacardium. 2. mustard.
 II. n. the Eleocarpus seed.
कृत-अञ्जलि- + पुट कृत-अञ्जलि- + पुट, adj. putting the hands together, Rām. 1, 9, 62.
कृत-त्रि- + पुण्ड्रक कृत-त्रि- + पुण्ड्रक, adj. provided with the three horizontal marks (see the last), Hariv. 15426.
कृत्रिम- + पुत्रक कृत्रिम- + पुत्रक, m. and f. त्रिका, a doll.
कृत- + भाव कृत- + भाव, adj. resolute, Rām. 6, 70, 12.
कृत- + मति कृत- + मति, adj. resolved, MBh. 13, 2211.
कृत- + मन्दार कृत- + मन्दार, m. A proper name, Rājat. 5, 35.
कृत- + मार्ग कृत- + मार्ग, adj. made accessible, Vikr. d. 21.
कृत- + युग कृत- + युग, n. = सत्य-युग, Man. 1, 85.
कृत- + योग्य कृत- + योग्य, adj. fighting perfectly, Johns. Sel. 12, 38.
कृत्रिम- + राग कृत्रिम- + राग, m. an artificial colour, Vikr. d. 40. []
कृत- + लक्षण कृत- + लक्षण, adj. brandished, Man. 9, 239.
कृत्ति- + वासस् कृत्ति- + वासस्, adj. covered with a skin, MBh. 2, 1642.
कृत- + विद्य कृत- + विद्य, adj. learned, Pañc. iv. d. 40.
कृत- + वेतन कृत- + वेतन, adj. hired, Yājñ. 2, 164.
कृत- + वेश कृत- + वेश, adj. dressed, Gīt. 11, 1.
कृत- + शिल्प कृत- + शिल्प, adj. one who has attained a knowledge of his art, Yājñ. 2, 184.
कृत- + श्रम कृत- + श्रम, adj. tired, Hit. iii. d. 110.
कृत- + संज्ञ कृत- + संज्ञ, adj. 1. ready-minded. 2. distinguished by appropriate marks, Man. 7, 190.
कृत- + हस्त कृत- + हस्त, adj. 1. skilled in archery, MBh. 4, 1843. 2. dexterous, clever.
